study.question: Which part of the residual learned-history benefit survives replacement by fixed target selection and a uniform mean? Baseline static/pooled/attention AUCs are 0.605004/0.610226/0.613362. Count+freshness reaches 0.618664 versus the equal-width repeated-summary control 0.612923. Replacing target-specific statistics by repeated global activity gives 0.613810 (time) and 0.613738 (presence), a negative branch. Removing the learned summary gives 0.617348 with time versus 0.618664 with attention, a 0.001316 deficit despite wall time 477.78 versus 611.40 seconds and peak allocation 380748288 versus 655454208 bytes. Scalar presence gives 0.615664 versus attention presence 0.618314: scalar time partly compensates for removal. The old pooled baseline lacks these scalar features, so it cannot isolate whether scoring is still necessary. All receipts succeeded; the scalar-only and activity branches are unsuccessful replacements, not runtime failures. No previous runtime error is reported.
study.hypothesis: Once count and conditional freshness statistics are directly exposed, some residual benefit of the learned event summary comes from identity/action/recency composition. A uniform mean over events matching the target category OR brand may recover that signal without the per-event scorer. With no match, use the full valid-history mean rather than a missing summary. Learned scores and fixed eligibility may interact, requiring the complete 2x2 comparison. This is a provisional local mechanism hypothesis, not a claim that exact matching captures all relevant interests.

nearest_work.difference: Exact v4 primary text read via tools.py read: content-sha256:5fee25f33f375e51b3ee9417d376ff9dbe2ea3628c932a7679ddfeb0feaaade2; lines 232-240 describe pooling; 250-277 describe candidate-dependent activation and abandoning softmax to preserve intensity. We inherit shared embeddings, pooling and target-aware readout ideas. This experiment instead holds direct count/freshness features fixed and crosses deterministic category-or-brand eligibility with normalized learned versus uniform weights. The local inherited model uses softmax and summed category/brand/action/recency vectors, so it is not an exact DIN reproduction. Pooling and target selection are established ideas; global novelty is unverified.

Exact author README at revision 2c6e76804281954a3c969010a31712cd5054aca9, content-sha256:656c9e5eec79c9843e907a555ede2bf0a66a0db3515916af3d655080057c5a75, lines 1-9, confirms category/brand/behavior histories without item identity. We preserve this boundary and do not add item matching or auxiliary item supervision. Publisher paper remains unavailable; README access does not verify DMR mechanisms or establish a detailed architectural difference.

Public history_g0_r0002_attention_time.py inspected. Its evidence, embeddings, model construction, summary/head width, optimizer and loss are inherited. Only summary eligibility and weighting are intervened on. attention_control is a functional replay with extra label-free diagnostics; global_mean is the previously missing pooling-with-scalars control.

inherited_components: Host-owned causal data construction, labels, sample identities, temporal split and validation scoring; static snapshot as-of dates remain undocumented.
Group/action log-count features scaled by log(129), mean exp(-age/86400) freshness per occupied cell, empty cells zero; all/category/brand/joint groups.
Shared 16-wide categorical embeddings, action and log-age embeddings; 16-wide learned summary; two 16-wide direct statistic slots; 128/64 MLP.
Default host training from scratch, optimizer and loss; no new data, auxiliary loss, installations or local training.
study.proposed_difference: A two-factor replacement study: eligibility is either every valid event or the union of nonzero-target category and brand matches, falling back to every valid event if that union is empty. Weighting is either the inherited normalized learned attention or the uniform mean of eligible embedded events. All cells still look up all events; no sparse lookup or parameter compression is claimed. Fixed-match uniform pooling is the mechanism-distinct candidate; global uniform pooling and gated attention are attribution controls, with ungated attention replay as reproducibility control. The study is an incremental local test of established components; novelty beyond the supplied local trajectories is unverified.
predictions: Prospective primary comparison: matched_mean AUC will exceed global_mean if fixed target selection contributes beyond all-event semantics; matched_mean should also exceed g0-r0002-scalar_time if its embedded composition is useful. Existing scalar_time is a contextual control; the new four cells provide the tightly matched contrasts.

Operational retention target, not an equivalence test: matched_mean is within 0.0005 AUC of attention_control and has lower measured train seconds and peak memory. If matched_mean exceeds global_mean but misses retention, fixed selection is useful yet insufficient.

If eligibility explains most learned retrieval, the learned-score gain attention_control minus global_mean will shrink in matched_attention minus matched_mean. Report both simple effects and their difference, without treating factorial interaction from one seed as repeated support.

attention_control should reproduce g0-r0002-attention_time AUC 0.6186637742234796 and logloss 0.1960500687413628 up to host numerical tolerance. Repeated identical-seed replay is a reproducibility check, not independent confirmation.

Diagnostics must show zero eligible events outside the valid mask and zero nonempty rows with no eligible events. Matchless rows use the all-event fallback; empty-history summaries are zero. First-512-row diagnostics are implementation checks, not population estimates.

Report frozen existing slices with sample/positive/negative counts. Category-match-present/absent differences are exploratory because eligibility also matches brands; do not relabel these as exact eligibility strata. The empty-history slice has only 310 positives and needs uncertainty caution.
falsifiers: If matched_mean does not improve global_mean, this specific fixed-match selector has no supported benefit; if both underperform attention_control, learned retrieval remains consequential under this recipe.

If matched_attention improves matched_mean substantially, deterministic eligibility alone cannot replace learned within-set scores. If gating hurts both scoring conditions, dropping unmatched context is a counterexample to the proposed locality rule.

If uniform methods do not reduce measured cost, no efficiency claim is supported even if AUC is retained. Four modules retain dormant scorer parameters, so registered compression is not a predicted outcome.
Failure to reproduce attention_control or nonzero eligibility invariant violations prevents attributing a new difference to the intended factors; diagnose before scientific interpretation.
No single seed, replay, or successful candidate establishes a general mechanism or novelty. No test feedback is authorized.
alternative_explanations: Count/freshness features already include target match statistics, so any remaining gate benefit could be a convenient nonlinear feature interaction rather than a new information source.
Gated means change event multiplicity and gradient allocation to shared embeddings; gains need not prove that selected events are causal user interests.

No-match fallback creates a mixture of global and local summaries. Harm may result from lost unmatched context, sparse selected support or hashed identity mismatch, not refutation of all fixed retrieval.

Time features and learned recency embeddings can compensate for each other, as suggested by the earlier time/presence factorial. Here both remain fixed; claims about independent temporal mechanisms require separate future controls.

Historical scalar-only loss could partly reflect reduced active capacity. New cells match registered parameter shapes and head input width, but removing scores still changes effective capacity and optimization.

Identical AUC across attention_time replays is deterministic reuse, not seed robustness. Validation selection, static snapshot uncertainty and repeated exposures constrain generalization; user-cluster uncertainty requires host-supported paired predictions.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: Runtime protocol estimated_unit_seconds=704.3729729604242, per-trial cap 1760.9324324010606, remaining_seconds=78321.6460404396 at resolution; g0-r0002 wall seconds 472.98-611.40, train seconds 386.66-521.18. Four full-data cells estimated 2817.49 seconds; conservative aggregate cap 7043.73 seconds. Uniform pooling retains event lookup but avoids scorer activations; no extrapolated speed claim.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Reserve eight full capped units (14087.46 seconds) for a discriminating follow-up or repeated mechanism contrasts. Diagnostics, failed calls, controls, preparation and any retries all consume the same ledger; no automatic retry if execution state is unknown.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve twelve capped units (21131.19 seconds) for up to four frozen selected/reference/control models at paired seeds 42,43,44, validation only, subject to the live ledger. Screening repeats at seed 42 are not independent repetitions. Freeze exact sources/configs and suite before final host assessment; no withheld/test access. If fewer units remain, reduce the suite and explicitly document omissions.
cost_plan.stop_rule: No local training. Submit four standalone variants to the authorized host. Recheck the live ledger before every later stage; do not start a cell if its full cap plus the remaining necessary attribution and assessment reserves will not fit. Stop on a hard limit, integrity failure or no useful admissible contrast. Neither budget exhaustion nor an unsuccessful branch is scientific success. Report AUC and unweighted logloss separately; compare measured training/inference cost and registered/active capacity under the matched recipe, without asserting an equal-compute frontier from unmatched runs.
